description: Source code for DecisionTreeRunner, an example application demonstrating decision trees and random forests using Apache Spark's MLlib. It includes data loading, model training, evaluation, and command-line argument parsing.

classes.name: DecisionTreeRunner
classes.description: Main object containing the application logic for training and evaluating decision trees and random forests.

classes.name: ImpurityType
classes.description: Enumeration for impurity measures: Gini, Entropy, Variance.

classes.name: Params
classes.description: Configuration parameters for the DecisionTreeRunner application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the application, parses command-line arguments and initiates data loading and model training.

methods.name: loadDatasets
methods.description: Loads training and test datasets from specified files, handles data format, class indexing, and dataset splitting.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the training and evaluation of decision tree or random forest models based on parameters.

methods.name: meanSquaredError
methods.description: Calculates mean squared error for regression models, overloaded for DecisionTreeModel and RandomForestModel.
